title: Home Assistant
summary: Control your Home Assistant from the deck: favourites, rooms, lights, scenes.
description: A client of your own Home Assistant server on the local network. Sign in by scanning a QR code with your phone, star favourites, browse rooms, switch lights and switches, set a light's brightness, run scenes and scripts, open covers and unlock locks after a confirmation, read sensors. Live states, greyed when offline. Not affiliated with the Home Assistant project. Needs Home Assistant on your network and a phone.
